---
title: "CMS Birthing Friendly Hospitals - Maps"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                       fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7.5)
```

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(sf)
  library(tigris)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# American Samoa, Guam, N. Mariana Islands, US Virgin Islands have no
# birthing-friendly hospitals in the raw data and no county boundaries worth
# plotting; AK/HI/PR are kept and relocated near the mainland for display.
DROP_ST <- c("60", "66", "69", "78")
```

```{r data}
hospitals_raw <- vroom::vroom(
  "raw/Birthing_Friendly_Hospitals_Geocoded.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

all_fips <- vroom::vroom("../../resources/all_fips.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
state_fips_lookup <- all_fips %>%
  filter(nchar(geography) == 2) %>%
  select(geography, state)

hospitals <- hospitals_raw %>%
  left_join(state_fips_lookup, by = "state") %>%
  filter(!geography %in% DROP_ST)

county_counts <- vroom::vroom("standard/data_county.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(geography, n_birthing_friendly = cms_birth_n_birthing_friendly)

states_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "5m", year = 2023, progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!STATEFP %in% DROP_ST) %>%
  transmute(geography = GEOID)

counties_sf <- tigris::counties(cb = TRUE, resolution = "5m", year = 2023, progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!STATEFP %in% DROP_ST) %>%
  transmute(geography = GEOID, state_fips = STATEFP)
```

```{r map1-points, fig.height=6.5}
hospitals_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(hospitals, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

states_shift <- tigris::shift_geometry(states_sf, geoid_column = "geography")
counties_shift_map1 <- tigris::shift_geometry(
  counties_sf %>% select(geography), geoid_column = "geography"
)
hospitals_shift <- tigris::shift_geometry(hospitals_sf, geoid_column = "geography")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states_shift, fill = "grey96", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = counties_shift_map1, fill = NA, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = states_shift, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = hospitals_shift, color = "#B2182B", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Birthing Friendly Hospitals") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13))
```

```{r map2-county-counts, fig.height=6.5}
county_map_data <- counties_sf %>%
  left_join(county_counts, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(
    n_birthing_friendly = coalesce(n_birthing_friendly, 0),
    # Most counties have 0-2 hospitals and a handful of large metro counties
    # have 10-40+, so bin (rather than a continuous scale) keeps the low end
    # visually distinct instead of being washed out by the outliers.
    n_bin = cut(n_birthing_friendly,
                breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 4, 9, 19, Inf),
                labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3-4", "5-9", "10-19", "20+"))
  )

county_shift <- tigris::shift_geometry(county_map_data, geoid_column = "geography")

ggplot(county_shift) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = n_bin), color = "white", linewidth = 0.03) +
  geom_sf(data = states_shift, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", name = "Hospitals") +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Number of Birthing Friendly Hospitals by County") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r map3-state-proportion, fig.height=6.5}
county_has_bf <- counties_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(has_bf = geography %in% county_counts$geography)

state_prop <- county_has_bf %>%
  group_by(geography = state_fips) %>%
  summarize(prop_with_bf = mean(has_bf), .groups = "drop")

state_map_data <- states_sf %>%
  left_join(state_prop, by = "geography")

state_prop_shift <- tigris::shift_geometry(state_map_data, geoid_column = "geography")

ggplot(state_prop_shift) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = prop_with_bf), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Proportion\nof counties",
                       labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of Counties with a Birthing Friendly Hospital, by State") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r map4-neighbor-access, fig.height=6.5}
has_bf <- counties_sf$geography %in% county_counts$geography

touch_list <- sf::st_touches(counties_sf)
neighbor_has_bf <- vapply(seq_along(touch_list), function(i) {
  nbrs <- touch_list[[i]]
  length(nbrs) > 0 && any(has_bf[nbrs])
}, logical(1))

county_neighbor_data <- counties_sf %>%
  mutate(
    has_bf = has_bf,
    status = case_when(
      has_bf              ~ "Has a birthing friendly hospital",
      neighbor_has_bf     ~ "No hospital, but a neighboring county has one",
      TRUE                ~ "No hospital in county or neighboring county"
    ),
    status = factor(status, levels = c(
      "Has a birthing friendly hospital",
      "No hospital, but a neighboring county has one",
      "No hospital in county or neighboring county"
    ))
  )

county_neighbor_shift <- tigris::shift_geometry(county_neighbor_data, geoid_column = "geography")

ggplot(county_neighbor_shift) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = status), color = "white", linewidth = 0.03) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Has a birthing friendly hospital" = "grey80",
      "No hospital, but a neighboring county has one" = "#4575B4",
      "No hospital in county or neighboring county" = "#D73027"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "County Access to a Birthing Friendly Hospital via Neighboring Counties") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
